about_the_game:
The world has declared war on God. In response, God has declared war on the world.

In other words—it’s time for that fucking crusade.

HOLY Intentions is a fast-paced fusion between a Souls-like and an ultraviolent FPS. History has been shattered, Earth itself rewritten, and an ancient cult—the Order of Majistos—rules from the shadows.

You are the Crusader, destined to tear their empire apart with blade, blood, and unrelenting holy fire.

Brutal, Visceral Combat

  • Command the Dragonsword, a living dragon forged into a weapon of divine wrath.

  • Wield devastating holy powers—like firing Lightning Nukes or calling down Comets from divine trebuchets.

  • Harness elemental movement: blast into the skies with Flame, walk on hurricanes, surf on lightning bolts.

  • Defy mortality: heal by taking damage.

An Epic Blend Between Religion and Fantasy

The Planet Graveyard—a star system where dying worlds and fallen civilizations are exiled to rot. Across this cosmic necropolis, Gothic cathedrals and towering spires cast their shadows over kingdoms in ruin. Here the Order of Majistos thrives, an ancient cult whose influence strangles every corner of existence.

Explore vast mystical levels to uncover the secrets of a world where even heaven itself has been cast into exile.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: 3.1GHz AMD Ryzen 3 or 3.3GHz Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RX 470 or GTX 1050
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: 3.5GHz AMD Ryzen 5 or Intel Core i7-6700K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RX 580 or GTX 1060
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
